offre.titre: Your account already has a monument
offre.description: The Free plan covers just one. Multi-monument lifts the limit and brings all your properties together on a single dashboard. Your draft stays here: it will resume exactly as it is.

perime.description: The questionnaire has changed since then: it is best to start again from your monument, which only takes a couple of minutes.

autre.titre: Your eligibility check could not be saved
autre.description: {{message}} Your answers have been kept: try again, nothing will be created twice.

introuvable.texte: This project does not exist or has been deleted.

onglets.label: Project sections
onglets.documentsTitre: Upload a document once and it serves all your applications

docsCta.titre: Keep your monument's documents in one place
docsCta.texte: Upload your quotes, orders, council resolutions and photos here. Monumia sorts them by type, and you can reuse them in each of your funding applications.

lancer.titre: Discover the funding for this project
lancer.texte: Our engine analyses the public and private funding schemes applicable to {{nom}}.

paywallEcheancier.description: The timeline brings together the deadlines of your funding schemes and applications, from the nearest to the furthest. The Watch plan also sends you email reminders.

aides.aucune: No funding to suggest for the moment.
aides.aucuneChez: No funding to suggest from ‘{{filtre}}’ for the moment.

maintenant.sous: Your project meets the conditions published by the funder, and the application window is open. You can prepare the application.

aDebloquer.sous: One step stands between you and these schemes: a protection, a label, an agreement or a membership. Open the scheme page to see which one, with whom and how long it takes.

aConfirmer.sous: We are missing one or more answers to know whether your project is eligible. They are asked on each scheme's page.

bientot.sous: The application window is closed or not yet open. Prepare your application for the next round: each scheme's badge shows where you stand on its criteria.

paywallBientot.titre: Be notified the day the application window opens
paywallBientot.description: These schemes cannot be submitted yet. The Watch plan emails you as soon as one of them opens, and gives access to its page: its organisation, its criteria and the supporting documents required.

dossiersVide.description: Open a funding scheme from the ‘Funding’ tab to start an application.

documents.intro: This project's documents. Those describing the monument (protection order, land registry, photos) stay on its page.
documents.vide: Quotes, plans, site photos: upload the documents specific to this works project here.

paywallEquipe.description: Invite your architect or craftspeople to this project only. They see its funding schemes, applications and documents, and nothing from your other projects.

refaire.description: The project's scope (your intentions, the works) is kept in both cases; only the questionnaire is redone, and the eligibility check is then recalculated.
refaire.passeesAide: Your current answers are kept: only the questions left unanswered are asked again.
refaire.toutAide: The questionnaire starts blank: your current answers will be replaced.

suppressionDialog.description: Its applications and their tracking will also be deleted. The monument's page, its documents and its team are not affected. This action cannot be undone.

toasts.dossierSupprime: Application deleted: the funding scheme is available again

pieces.deposeTexte: The application has been submitted: its documents can no longer be changed.

dialogDepot.description: Do this once the application has been sent to the funder: Monumia does not send it on your behalf. The documents can no longer be changed, and the scheme's progress will change to ‘Submitted’. You can cancel this submission.

dialogSuppression.description: The application and its attached documents will be removed. The funding scheme will be available again in the ‘Funding’ tab. This action cannot be undone.
